description: Sprint 3, after FEAT-002: add only the minimal B2d1 run-specific support, wait for an idle GPU, run the complete 104-task trial synchronously on one RTX 5060 Ti replica, verify outputs/metrics/protected hashes, append one status pointer, then complete one test/act checkpoint and one local Sprint 3 commit.
steps: Extend RunSpec with max_agent_steps and replicas, apply those fields in live_runner, permit the B2d1 CLI id without changing the meaning of all, and add a B2d1 trial.yaml block using the B1 adapter, existing prototypes/threshold, max_agent_steps=2, replicas=1. Leave B0/B1/B2 unchanged and add CPU-only config/CLI tests.

Before launch, rerun targeted tests, compare protected hashes, verify model revision af89d219b53ed9b13b8a4645f9c8028973510324, and wait until a fresh process query finds no run_trial.py. Verify CUDA index 1 is NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti and has capacity for one replica.

From the isolated lexsi directory run in the foreground: $env:ACTPROTO_CUDA_DEVICES="1"; .\.venv\Scripts\python scripts\run_trial.py --run B2d1. Monitor terminal output through exit 0; require 104 tasks on one replica and gpu=1 progress. Never treat launch as completion.

Verify results/b0_b2/B2d1/eval.json and eval.md. Assert n_tasks=104, replicas=["1"], at most two calls per row, first_tool_accuracy=1.0, and presence/reporting of first_argument_correctness, task_success, and latency_p50. If first-tool accuracy drops, fix C1/A1 and rerun before reporting.
Compare every protected hash to the pre-Sprint-1 manifest. Append exactly one pointer with the four measured metrics and B2 1.000 comparison to docs/EXPERIMENT_STATUS.md without rewriting it.

After the live run, run Sprint 3 targeted tests, full pytest, and the act CI attempt. Record exact act environmental errors if any. Commit only run plumbing/config/tests and the status pointer with message feat(actproto): add the B2 depth-1 live trial; keep ignored B2d1 outputs unstaged. Never push.
acceptance_criteria: No run_trial.py overlaps the launch; B2d1 completes in the foreground on physical CUDA device 1 with exactly one replica.

B2d1 writes eval.json and eval.md for n=104, every trajectory has at most two calls, first-tool accuracy is exactly 1.000, and first-argument accuracy, verified task success, and median latency are reported.
Protected adapters, prototypes, metrics, and B0/B1/B2 trees have identical SHA-256 manifests before and after the trial.
docs/EXPERIMENT_STATUS.md receives one appended pointer only.
Targeted and full local pytest pass, the act attempt is truthfully recorded, and exactly one Sprint 3 commit contains only G1/support files.
verification: Before launch from the isolated lexsi directory: .\.venv\Scripts\python -m pytest tests/test_trial_config.py tests/test_run_trial.py tests/test_routed_strategy.py tests/test_arg_prompt.py tests/test_evaluation.py tests/test_comparison.py
Run a venv Python JSON assertion for n_tasks=104, replicas=["1"], first_tool_accuracy=1.0, four required average metrics, and per-row maximum two predicted_tools.
Compare the post-run protected SHA-256 manifest with the pre-Sprint-1 manifest and require zero differences.

After the trial from the isolated lexsi directory: .\.venv\Scripts\python -m pytest tests/test_trial_config.py tests/test_run_trial.py tests/test_routed_strategy.py tests/test_arg_prompt.py tests/test_evaluation.py tests/test_comparison.py && .\.venv\Scripts\python -m pytest (run as separate PowerShell commands on this host).
From the worktree root: act -W ".github/workflows/ci.yml" -j test
Using git -C C:\Users\arian\Github\Hackathons\lexsi\.worktrees\plan-2-execution, inspect the Sprint 3 commit, three-commit history, clean tracked status, and retained ignored B2d1 outputs.
findings: COMPLETED Sprint 3 in the isolated worktree only.
